opening.argument: The video provides a practical walkthrough for using a Bitcoin wallet, beginning with the instruction to open the wallet and access the BTC deposit function: "To do deposit for Bitcoin just open your wallet from Plustoken and go to access and click on BTC at the bottom right you will see deposit click on deposit." It then explains how the wallet displays a QR code and address and how to copy that address: "then you will load qr code and also the address so there's a button say replicating address so basically it's copying the address." Although an example send is demonstrated, the supplied frame shows CAD 500 entered with an "Insufficient funds" message and no completed transfer. Nothing supplied shows a fixed-return promise, deceptive claim, credential request, or other manipulative mechanism. The observable conduct is therefore best understood as a wallet-use tutorial and operational technology demonstration.
